body.name: Branch-relevant deterministic sieve
body.construction: For a sufficiently large fixed \(C\), let \(H_n\) be the set of histogram draws satisfying \(\|s-e\|_\infty\le C\rho_n\), \(\|u_0-\mu_0\|_{L_2(P_X)}+\|u_1-\mu_1\|_{L_2(P_X)}\le C\varepsilon_n\), \(\sup_{x\le c+C\rho_n}|u_0(x)-\mu_0(x)|\le C\rho_n\), and \(\sup_{x\ge c-C\rho_n}|u_1(x)-\mu_1(x)|\le C\rho_n\), where \(\rho_n=J_n^{-1}+\sqrt{J_n\log n/n}\) and \(\varepsilon_n=J_n^{-1}+\sqrt{J_n(\log n)^2/n}\).
